## AI usage log {#ai-usage-log}

Per course policy, the analytical framing, the topic, the village selection, the source list, and all factual claims are the author's. I used Claude (Anthropic) in a supporting role across the writing and the build, with the responsibilities below.

| Role | Tool / Model | What it was used for |
|---|---|---|
| Boilerplate code | Claude | Quarto and SCSS setup, plotting helper functions, occasional debugging |
| Proofreading | Claude | Light copy-editing on draft prose for grammar and clarity |
| Reference checks | Claude | Cross-checking dataset names and citation formats against the cited source |
| Drafting and structural editing | Claude | Drafting paragraph scaffolds and section transitions from the author's notes and outline. The author then rewrote each draft to match the project's voice and verified every factual claim against a primary source listed in the footnotes. |

All sources were verified by the author. No AI was used to generate any of the imagery in this project.
